name: NetZero
source:
Countries from all around the world had initially settled on an agreement for reducing carbon emissions by 2030. As years passed, ecosystems began fading, But by 2050, society didn’t reach that goal, leaving the world damaged beyond repair. As civilizations eventually demolished, the last remaining population resorted to other means of survival and technologies to prevent the human race from reaching the brink of extinction. Clarima, a company that has gained traction by becoming the main contributor to society’s survival, is why people could live a simple lifestyle once more. But unbeknownst to the remaining populace of the world, an unforeseen capsule has been discovered within the Arctic, revealing a treasure trove of frozen mysteries and secrets. Upon this discovery, a sporadic timeline of events began occurring, and soon enough, the Earth was invaded by sentient beings who then revived the Earth in its entirety. But that is not their only objective, as all humans are at the mercy of these sacred creatures, slain on sight without hesitation.

[From [url=https://diwbe.itch.io/netzero]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界各国最初达成了到2030年减少碳排放的协议。随着时间的推移，生态系统开始衰退，但到2050年，社会并没有实现这一目标，使世界受到无法修复的损害。随着文明最终被摧毁，最后剩下的人口诉诸其他生存手段和技术来防止人类走向灭绝的边缘。Clarima是一家通过成为社会生存的主要贡献者而受到关注的公司，这就是人们可以再次过上简单生活方式的原因。但世界上剩下的人们不知道的是，在北极发现了一个意想不到的胶囊，揭示了一个充满冰冻奥秘和秘密的宝库。在这一发现之后，一系列零星的事件开始发生，很快，地球就被众生入侵，然后众生使地球焕然一新。但这并不是他们唯一的目标，因为所有人类都受到这些神圣生物的摆布，被毫不犹豫地杀死。
